description: A fat pink worm, still coiling slowly. Mirewart eats them by the dozen and leaves the tough ones.
lore: It is the only thing on a junk stall that moves, so it is kept in a tin and sold the same day. Bait, mostly. But the fen-walkers buy them for the reading: what [[monsters/mystical_frog|the frog]] passes over is what has been in that water longest, so a fat tough one out of a shallow means the shallow has been a shallow for years and will still be there when you come back. A crossing full of thin new worms is a crossing that was somewhere else last season. Cross it early, and cross it once.
gm_notes: The Drift read off the bottom of a fen. Usable at the table as a crossing check: fat worms mean old ground, thin ones mean the water is new here.
